teaser: Every link a gift link: a reply to John Saroff on paywalls and dark social, from a newsroom with no paywall and a meter for what is read.
core_idea: John Saroff asks whether a reader arriving through a trusted recommendation should be asked to pay at once or offered a relationship, as dark social grows and gift links spread; this newsroom answers in production with no paywall, £5 of credit and no account, a meter that charges for the share of each page actually read, a page not charged if it was not worth it, and no page ever blocked, so every link is a gift link, and the relationship grows on the reader's side, in their browser, shared only when they choose.
